packages.title: Munnar, Thekkady and Alleppey houseboat
packages.description: Experience the quintessential beauty of God’s Own Country across six unforgettable days. Journey through the mist-shrouded emerald tea plantations of Munnar, explore the rich spice gardens and Periyar wildlife sanctuary in Thekkady, and culminate your holiday with an exclusive private houseboat cruise through the peaceful palm-lined backwaters of Alleppey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cochin & Transfer to Munnar (130 km / 4 hrs)
itinerary.description: Warm reception at Cochin International Airport or Ernakulam Railway Station by our private chauffeur. Drive uphill toward Munnar past cascading Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check in at your luxury hillside resort. Evening at leisure overlooking verdant valleys.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Estates & Eravikulam National Park
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Eravikulam National Park, home of the endangered Nilgiri Tahr mountain goat. Later, visit the KDHP Tea Museum and explore Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Lake. Private tea-tasting session included.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady Spice Hills (95 km / 3 hrs)
itinerary.description: Scenic drive across the Western Ghats to Thekkady (Periyar). Afternoon guided walking tour through organic cardamom, pepper, and vanilla plantations. Evening attend a live traditional Kalaripayattu martial arts performance.

itinerary.title: Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary & Transfer to Alleppey (140 km / 4 hrs)
itinerary.description: Early morning boat cruise on Periyar Lake inside the wildlife sanctuary to spot wild elephants, gaur, and rare birds. Proceed downhill to Alleppey. Check in at your traditional backwater resort. Relax by Vembanad Lake.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Deluxe Private Houseboat Cruise
itinerary.description: Board your private traditional Kettuvallam houseboat at 12:00 noon. Cruise through the narrow canal networks, paddy fields below sea level, and rustic villages. Freshly prepared Kerala lunch, evening tea with banana fritters, and candlelit dinner served on board.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Houseboat Check-out & Cochin Departure (75 km / 2 hrs)
itinerary.description: Savor morning breakfast while gliding past tranquil morning backwaters. Check out at 09:30 AM. Chauffeur transfer to Cochin International Airport with sweet memories of Kerala.

inclusions: Accommodation in verified 4-star category resorts on twin-sharing basis
1 night private deluxe air-conditioned houseboat stay with all meals on board
Daily buffet breakfast and dinner at hotels
Exclusive AC sedan/SUV with professional English/Hindi-speaking chauffeur
Guided spice plantation walk in Thekkady
All toll, parking, fuel charges, and driver allowances
exclusions: Airfare or train tickets to/from Cochin
Personal expenses, laundry, and telephone calls
Optional boating tickets at Periyar Lake or Mattupetty Dam
Anything not explicitly mentioned in the inclusions

packages.seoDescription: Book our bestselling 6-day Kerala holiday package. Explore Munnar tea hills, Periyar wildlife sanctuary, and an authentic Alleppey luxury houseboat stay.

packages.title: Madurai, Rameswaram and Kanyakumari
packages.description: A spiritually enriching journey through Tamil Nadu’s most revered heritage capitals. Marvel at the intricate Dravidian gopurams of Madurai Meenakshi Temple, cross the legendary Pamban Sea Bridge to Rameswaram Ramanathaswamy Temple, and stand at the southernmost tip of peninsular India where three oceans meet at Kanyakumari.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Madurai & Meenakshi Amman Temple
itinerary.description: Arrival at Madurai Airport/Railway station. Check in at comfortable 3-star hotel. In the evening, witness the divine night ceremony and intricate carvings of Sri Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple.

itinerary.title: Madurai to Rameswaram via Pamban Bridge (175 km / 3.5 hrs)
itinerary.description: Drive to the sacred island of Rameswaram across the historic Pamban Bridge. Visit Ramanathaswamy Temple known for its magnificent 1000-pillar corridor and sacred 22 theerthams. Visit Dhanushkodi ghost town and Ram Setu point.

itinerary.title: Rameswaram to Kanyakumari (310 km / 6 hrs)
itinerary.description: Morning journey along the Coromandel coast to Kanyakumari, the confluence of the Arabian Sea, Indian Ocean, and Bay of Bengal. Check in and witness the breathtaking sunset from the shore.

itinerary.title: Kanyakumari Sightseeing & Trivandrum Transfer
itinerary.description: Early morning sunrise view. Ferry ride to Vivekananda Rock Memorial and Thiruvalluvar Statue. Visit Gandhi Memorial Mandapam and Bhagavathy Amman Temple. Afternoon drive to Trivandrum (90 km / 2.5 hrs).

itinerary.title: Padmanabhaswamy Temple & Trivandrum Departure
itinerary.description: Morning darshan at the magnificent Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple. Later drop at Trivandrum Airport or Railway Station for onward journey.

inclusions: 4 nights accommodation in clean 3-star hotels on twin-sharing basis
Daily breakfast and dinner
Private air-conditioned commercial vehicle with courteous chauffeur
All state permits, parking fees, and toll taxes
exclusions: Temple special entry / darshan tickets and camera charges
Ferry tickets at Kanyakumari
Any personal expenses or meals not specified
packages.seoTitle: Madurai, Rameswaram & Kanyakumari 5 Days Temple Tour | WanderCMS
packages.seoDescription: Explore South India heritage with our 5-day Madurai, Rameswaram, and Kanyakumari temple and coastal holiday package.

packages.title: Wayanad Rainforest, Waterfalls and Wildlife Retreat
packages.description: Immerse in the misty rainforest canopy of Wayanad in northern Kerala. Trek to the historic Edakkal Caves with Neolithic petroglyphs, bamboo raft along tranquil Kuruva Island, and rejuvenate in luxury plantation tree-houses surrounded by cardamom estates.

itinerary.title: Calicut Arrival & Drive to Wayanad Ghats (85 km / 2.5 hrs)
itinerary.description: Pick-up from Calicut Airport/Station. Drive up the Thamarassery Churam mountain pass with 9 hairpin curves. Check in to secluded rainforest resort.

itinerary.title: Edakkal Caves & Soochipara Waterfalls
itinerary.description: Hike to the ancient Edakkal Caves followed by an excursion to Soochipara 3-tiered waterfall cascading through dense evergreen forests.

itinerary.title: Banasura Sagar Dam & Kuruva Island Bamboo Rafting
itinerary.description: Visit India’s largest earthen dam at Banasura Sagar with speed boating. Afternoon bamboo rafting on the Kabini River tributaries at Kuruva Island.

itinerary.title: Tea Plantation Tour & Calicut Departure
itinerary.description: Morning walk in organic coffee and pepper plantations. Check out and return to Calicut for your flight or train.

inclusions: 3 nights stay in luxury eco-plantation resort
Daily breakfast and authentic Malabar dinners
Private AC vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
Guided spice plantation trek
exclusions: Boating tickets and sanctuary entry fees
Airfare/Train tickets
Personal items

enquiryReplies.draftContent:
Dear Vikram,

Greetings from WanderCMS, Kochi!

Thank you for reaching out regarding your family holiday to Kerala for 2 adults and 1 child this December. We would be delighted to host you.

Based on your requirement for a 5-6 night journey with a private luxury houseboat and a budget of ₹1,20,000, our bestselling package "Munnar, Thekkady and Alleppey houseboat" (PKG-KL-07, 6 Days / 5 Nights) is an ideal match. During peak season in December, the verified package rate is ₹32,500 per person on a twin-sharing basis (plus 5% GST), perfectly accommodating your family within budget.

This journey features:
• 2 nights in the misty tea plantations of Munnar
• 1 night amidst the spice hills of Thekkady (Periyar)
• 1 night backwater resort stay
• 1 full day & night on your private, air-conditioned luxury houseboat in Alleppey with all traditional Kerala meals prepared on board
• Private air-conditioned car with a seasoned chauffeur throughout.

Please let us know if your travel dates are flexible so we can reserve your houseboat slot.

Warm regards,
Travel Specialist Team
WanderCMS, Kochi
